tieu_de: RITUAL FOR RECITING THE BUDDHA CROWN VICTORY DHARANI
noi_dung:
RITUAL FOR RECITING THE UṢṆĪṢA VIJAYA DHĀRAṆĪ

1. Three-Family Universal Homage Mantra:
Om ! Tat tha ga to bat mo Vajiro vat. (7 times)

I. Wholeheartedly Paying Homage:
To the World-Honored Vairocana Muni Buddha of the Central World.
To the World-Honored Akṣobhya Buddha of the Eastern World.
To the World-Honored Ratnasaṃbhava Buddha of the Southern World.
To the World-Honored Amitābha Buddha of the Western World.
To the World-Honored Amoghasiddhi Buddha of the Northern World.
To all Buddhas of the ten directions and three periods of time.
(1 prostration)

II. Wholeheartedly Paying Homage:
To the All-Tathāgatas Abhiṣeka Purifying-All-Realms, Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Stainless Light Dhāraṇī.
To the honored Dharma throughout the ten directions and three periods of time.
(1 prostration)

III. Wholeheartedly Paying Homage:
Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva
Samantabhadra Bodhisattva
Avalokiteśvara (Guan Yin) Bodhisattva
Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva
Maitreya Bodhisattva
Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva
Ākāśagarbha Bodhisattva
Victorious Lotus-Treasury Bodhisattva
And all Noble Saṅgha throughout the ten directions and three periods of time. (1 prostration)

(Sit cross-legged with palms joined, recite the mantras and praise verse as follows):

2. Purification of the Dharma Realm Mantra:
Om ! Ran. (108 times)
(Purification of the Dharma Realm Mudrā)

3. Body-Protection Mantra:
Om ! Si ran. (108 times)
(Body-Protection Mudrā)

4. Wish-Fulfilling Jewel King Mantra:
Om ! A Van Ran Han Khan Ma ni Pat me hum. (108 times)
(Wish-Fulfilling Jewel Mudrā)

Praise Verse:
I bow in homage to Śākyamuni, the Great Tamer of Beings,
And the Three Holy Ones welcoming beings to the Western Pure Land.
Eighty-eight koṭis of Buddhas like sands of the Ganges in ten directions
Have all proclaimed this stainless light that purifies all realms.
The wondrous gate of the Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Dhāraṇī
Can eradicate all karmic offenses and obstacles,
Bring forth boundless blessings and wisdom,
Deliver beings from the three realms and six paths,
And swiftly ferry them to the other shore according to their vows.
With sincere devotion, I now receive and uphold this mantra,
Vowing to leave the Sahā world and be reborn in Ultimate Bliss.
Namo Buddhas and Bodhisattvas of the Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Assembly. (3 times)

(After finishing the mantra, join your palms and recite the Praise Verse):

Praise:
Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Dhāraṇī,
Merits vast as Ganges sands,
Shatters Yama’s realms of woe,
Scattering maṇḍalas of flowers,
Delivering beings from Sahā
To the supreme Lotus Pure Land.
Namo Eighty-Eight Koṭis of Buddhas like Ganges Sands Proclaiming this Wondrous Gate of Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya. (3 times)

6. Vast Unfailing Maṇi Universal Offering Mantra:
By the power of the Dharma Realm,
The blessing of all Buddhas and Sages,
And the power of my own wholesome merit,
May universal offerings abide everywhere.
Namo Universal Offering Bodhisattva. (3 times)
Om ! A mo ga Vi bu la Ma ni Pat do ma Va ji ri Sat va Tat tha ga ta A va lo ki te Sa manh ta Bo ra Sa ra Hum. (7 times)
(Form the Maṇi Universal Offering Mudrā, then hold the Issuing Universal Offering Mudrā at the crown of the head and recite the syllable “Om” 21 times)

7. Heart-Center Fulfilling-All-Wishes Mantra:
Om ! Su ru Su ru Va ra Va ra Sam va ra Sam va ra In di ri da Vi suyt da ni Hum Hum Ru ru Cha le Ca ru Cha le Soa ha. (7 times)
(Hold the Secret Crown-Wheel Mudrā)

8. Great Victorious Buddha-Crown Mantra: (Blazing Flame Mudrā)
Om ! Ma ha Hoa ji ra U sac Ni sa Quan Hum Tra hac ri at Ta re Tuyt ta re Tu re phat A sam man Nghi ni Si ran Bo rum. (7 times)
(Then stand up to perform the Repentance Homage)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Lord of Liberation World, Namo Space-Merit, Pure Stainless Eyes, Subtle Dust Equal Comeliness, Marks of Merit, Radiant Blossom, Padma Flaming Beryl Color, Precious Essence Fragrance, Supreme Fragrance, Wondrous Offering, Manifold Exquisite Adornments, Boundless Inconceivable Crown Mark, Sun-Moon Radiance, Vow-Power Adornment, Transformation Adornment, Vast Adornment, Dharma-Realm Supreme Unstained Jewel King Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Sovereign Light World, Well-Renowned Auspicious King Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Wondrous Jewel World, Jewel-Moon Wisdom-Adorned Sound-Sovereign King Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Perfected Fragrance World, Golden Jewel-Light Wondrous-Conduct Accomplished Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Sorrowless World, Sorrowless Supreme Auspicious Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Dharma-Banner World, Dharma-Ocean Thunder-Sound Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Well-Abiding Jewel-Ocean World, Dharma-Ocean Supreme-Wisdom Supernormal-Power Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Pure Beryl World, Medicine Master Beryl Radiance Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Unobstructed World, Indra-Banner Star-King Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Blissful Joy World, Universal Radiance Merit-Adorned Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the All-Entering World, Skilled-in-Battle Invincible Transcendent Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

With one mind I bow and take refuge in the Wondrous-Sound Brightness World, Jewel-Lotus Well-Abiding Śāla-Tree King Tathāgata. (1 prostration)

9. Buddha-Mindfulness and Merit Dedication

Kneel with palms joined, recite the Buddha’s name, and read the full dedication below.

I take refuge and bow to Amitābha Buddha
In the Western World of Peaceful Bliss.
Now I make the vow to be reborn there;
I humbly implore Your Great Compassion to embrace and receive me.
Namo Amitābha Buddha, Greatly Compassionate Guiding Teacher of the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss.

Namo Amitābha Buddha (10 breaths)
Namo Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva (3 breaths)
Namo Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva (3 breaths)
Namo Pure Great Ocean Assembly of Bodhisattvas. (3 breaths)

Repentance and Vows

Now as I recite this dhāraṇī, bow, and repent,
May I generate the vast mind of Bodhi.
May concentration and wisdom soon become clear and complete.
May all wholesome merits be fulfilled.
May supreme blessings everywhere adorn me.
May all karmic obstacles be completely extinguished.
All unwholesome acts created since beginningless time,
Born from beginningless greed, anger, and delusion,
Committed through body, speech, and mind—
Of all these I now sincerely repent. (Half-bow)

Four Great Vows

Sentient beings are countless; I vow to deliver them all.
Afflictions are endless; I vow to sever them all.
Dharma gates are measureless; I vow to master them all.
The Buddha Way is unsurpassed; I vow to attain it.

Vow of Rebirth in the Pure Land

May I know in advance the time of my passing,
Be free of every obstruction and hindrance,
Behold face to face the Three Holy Ones of the Western Pure Land,
And immediately be reborn in the Land of Ultimate Bliss.

Merit Dedication

May this supreme and wondrous merit
Repay the four heavy debts and benefit the three realms.
May all sentient beings throughout the Dharma Realm
Be reborn in Ultimate Bliss and accomplish Buddhahood.

10. Closing Homage

Stand up and chant the closing homages.

With one mind I pay homage to the ever-abiding Three Jewels: all Buddhas, the honored Dharma, and the noble Saṅgha throughout all space and the Dharma Realm, past, present, and future. (1 prostration)

With one mind I pay homage to Śākyamuni Buddha, Teacher of this Sahā world, the Eighty-Eight Koṭis of Buddhas like Ganges Sands throughout the ten directions, and the Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Stainless Light Dhāraṇī they proclaim. (1 prostration)

With one mind I pay homage to our Guiding Teacher and Compassionate Father Amitābha Buddha of the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, Greatly Compassionate Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Greatly Mighty Mahāsthāmaprāpta Bodhisattva, and the Pure Great Ocean Assembly of Bodhisattvas. (1 prostration)
(Ring the bell three times, bow three times, and withdraw.)
